core_obligations: Reduce to the affine case Spec(B) -> Spec(A) with A -> B finite, and write F = M-tilde (proof lines 2302-2306).
Apply the algebra lemma to see that M is finite over B exactly when it is finite over A (proof lines 2307-2309).
Use the dictionary between finite type modules and their associated sheaves to conclude (proof lines 2310-2312).
difficulty_reason: For a finite morphism f and a quasi-coherent O_X-module F, the lemma asserts that F is of finite type if and only if f_* F is (statement lines 2291-2299). The proof is the finite-type analogue of its finitely presented sibling: finiteness makes f affine, reducing to Spec(B) -> Spec(A) with A -> B finite and F = M-tilde, and the algebraic input is that a B-module M is finite exactly when it is finite over A, after which the dictionary between finite type modules and their associated sheaves concludes (proof lines 2301-2312). The level is H2: a clean two-step reduction with the one nontrivial algebra lemma named.
